profile: Sustainability consultant with over four years in environmental footprinting, EU environmental legislation and multi-stakeholder facilitation. Calculates product and corporate carbon footprints to GHG Protocol and ISO 14040 methodology, produces Environmental Product Declarations, and translates EU product legislation into practical requirements for clients and their suppliers. Chaired a 53-member industry consortium across five countries, facilitating between differing member mandates and carrying agreed actions through to closure.

experience.title: LCA & Sustainability Consultant (Contract)
bullets: Calculate product and corporate carbon footprints for B2B clients on GHG Protocol methodology across Scope 1, 2 and 3, spanning building materials, industrial and automotive component manufacturers
Run life cycle assessments in OneClick LCA to ISO 14040, 14044 and 14067, and produce the Environmental Product Declarations built on EN 15804 and ISO 14025 datasets
Model bill-of-materials footprints on manufactured goods, defining the supplier data requests and the evidence each material-level input has to carry
Interpret EU environmental legislation across ESPR, PPWR, EUDR, EmpCo and CBAM, and translate each obligation into practical requirements for client products, packaging and suppliers
Substantiate product environmental claims with life cycle and EPD evidence under the Empowering Consumers directive, assessing greenwashing exposure before claims reach the market
Lead client engagements from scoping and methodology through to delivery against agreed deadlines, and coach client teams on footprinting methodology and data governance
Pilot new footprinting and data-collection methods on a single client and product line, then extend them across the wider portfolio once the approach holds

experience.title: Sustainability Strategy and Stakeholder Dialogue (Work Study)

Completed EU Taxonomy eligibility and alignment assessments and aligned CSRD reporting with ESRS E1, documenting the evidence behind each classification
Steered a cross-functional project team across Compliance, Risk, Legal, IT and supply chain, setting deliverables and holding contributors to deadlines without direct authority
Presented regulatory developments and analysis to senior leadership with recommendations, and delivered group-wide training as e-learning modules

experience.title: Disclosures (Work Study)
bullets: Served as primary point of contact for 150+ organisations globally, resolving methodology, data-quality and deadline queries through a full disclosure cycle
Supported the CDP-hosted workshop in Warsaw and ran feedback calls with disclosing and prospective organisations
